objective: It's clear that you are a great fighter. However, such strength is wasted by serving the Light. There are powers beyond what the brothers in the cathedral can show you. Powers of shadow, and the damned. Perhaps after you've seen enough of the world, you will come to understand this as I have.
Here, take this. This was passed to me as I am now passing it to you. Perhaps a taste of this power will change your perspective.
